snippet.title: The Dark Heart of Balor - Game Trailer (EA)
snippet.description:
We are happy to announce "The Dark Heart of Balor" - the game we've been working on! It is a 3D hack and slash side scroller where you play as a hunter in a demon infested dark fantasy world.
WHISHLIST on STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1247580/The_Dark_Heart_of_Balor/
